column2: [intro]
In my head, a film is playing,
Images that give me chills, swaying,
A visual memory, quite a puzzle,
I’m a real cameraman, without a huddle.
I have a visual memory, it's not mundane,
I remember all in my mental plane,
Memories roll by, it's almost magic,
But sometimes it leads to moments comic.
I remember that day, with my band of friends,
We were young, carefree, a bit on trends,
We did something silly, it was truly fun,
But only I can still see that funny run.
I have a visual memory, I do wonders,
I can relive every moment, with all its splendors,
But sometimes it tricks me, won't let me go,
I recall mistakes, embarrassing moments, it's quite a show.
[ solo ]
I have a visual memory, it's not always easy,
But I'm a storyteller, a director breezy,
I take you to my constant cinema,
Welcome to my head, my fascinating panorama.
[ outro ]
